snippet.title: Mortal Shell II - Open Beta Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Mortal Shell II Open Beta Now on Steam: https://s.team/a/4711740 
It’s time to claim what’s yours! 

------------------------
Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. 

Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
